why: Issue #1015. The open stops starting the load, so the Configuration body is never built and the pane shows its heading and Back alone. This is the negative control for THE CONTROL case and for every adapted case that awaits the body. It is also the only entry scoped to `hud.reachability.devconfig.test.ts`, deliberately: it is that walk's proof that it waits for the body (`LAYER_REACH['developer-config'].body`) rather than walking the shell's Back and passing -- which it did before the wait, measured against this mutant. The cost is that file's 163-step walk (about 29s locally, about 87s on a CI shard) in the baseline, under the harness's 180s kill.
